entities.summary: Marco Mellino is an Italian prelate of the Catholic Church who serves as Secretary of the Council of Cardinals. He has been a titular bishop since 2018, and worked as Adjunct Secretary to that Council from 2018 to 2020. He has worked as a parish priest, trained as a canon lawyer, and spent significant time working in the Vatican's Secretariat of State.
